title: Endpoint of a walk
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph on a vertex type $V$, with neighbor choices indexed by $	ext{Fin}(D)$. Starting at a vertex $v$, follow the neighbor indexed by each successive entry of a finite list of indices; the endpoint is the vertex reached after all choices, and is $v$ when the list is empty.
hypotheses_covered: A vertex type with decidable equality
